body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Axxen Korea unveiled a new music album ''Playdisc'' with a built-in player at KES 2006. The company claims that this Playdisc substitutes for traditional CDs, cassette tapes, and MD and users can listen music anywhere and anytime with this player as well as they can have it as long-term album collection.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
